name: Flights
author: Eric
summary: Compares round-trip fares, builds Skyscanner links, and watches routes for bag-included price drops.
starterPrompt: Compare round-trip flights for this route in USD, including checked baggage and sensible layovers.
usageNote: Recheck fares, baggage rules, layovers, visa needs, and total price on the airline or booking site before booking.
